html.htmlText:
As an accommodation provider, we are obligated to do the following:

• Register your stay with the Foreign Police – In accordance with Czech law (§ 102 and § 101 of Act No. 326/1999 Sb.), we are required to report the presence of foreign guests and keep a record of accommodated individuals. To fulfill this obligation, we will send you registration forms one day before your arrival.

• Collect the city tax – As required by local regulations, a city tax of 50 CZK (or 2 EUR) per person per night must be collected upon check-in. Please have the correct amount in cash ready to ensure a smooth check-in process.

*Completing these is a necessary condition for staying in our apartment.*

disclaimer.title: How reviews work
disclaimer.subtitle: Reviews from past guests help our community learn more about each home. By default, reviews are sorted by relevancy. Relevancy is based on recency, length, and information that you provide to us, such as your booking search, your country, and your language preferences. Only the guest who booked the reservation can leave a review, and Airbnb only moderates reviews flagged for not following our policies. To be eligible for a percentile ranking or guest favorite label, listings need at least 5 reviews in the last 4 years. Criteria is subject to change. Learn more in our Help Center

section.about:
SOHO Old Town is a premier boutique residence newly opened in 2026 after a complete reconstruction. Located in the historic heart of Prague, it blends heritage architecture with refined modern design.

The property features a private interior garden and backyard—a rare "city oasis" providing a tranquil escape from the urban bustle. Our Premium Suites offer high-end finishes just steps from Charles Bridge, National Theater, the Vltava River, and Old Town Square.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Welcome to a stylish and comfortable apartment 33m2/ 355 sq. f. in a beautifully restored historic building in Old Town Prague. The location is exceptional. Charles Bridge is a 3-minute walk, Old Town Square just 5 minutes away, and the Vltava River only 100 meters from the apartment, yet the stay remains quiet and private. The building features a peaceful inner courtyard, a rare place to relax in the city center. Ideal for families, groups, and business travelers. Welcome to Soho Old Town!

The space
Excellent Location: Conveniently located in Prague, within walking distance to the most famous landmarks of Prague, as well as cafés, restaurants, and public transport.

Comfortable Accommodation: The apartment features one separate bedroom and additional sleeping options, comfortably accommodating up to 4 guests, making it suitable for small groups.

Modern Bathroom: Clean, contemporary, and fully equipped for your comfort.

Fully Equipped Kitchen: Prepare meals with ease using modern appliances and all essential kitchen equipment.

Entertainment Included: Enjoy a TV with Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, and a PlayStation 5, perfect for relaxing after a day out.

FREE Wi-Fi: Fast and reliable internet for work, streaming, and staying connected.

Stylish & Cozy Interior: High quality beds, comfortable seating, and elegant décor create a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere.

Make the most of your stay in Prague with this well designed apartment offering comfort, functionality, and an excellent location for a memorable visit.

Welcome to Soho Old Town!

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire apartment during your stay, ensuring complete privacy and comfort during your stay. Please make yourself at home and let us know if you have any questions or concerns during your stay. We are here to help.

Other things to note
If you're arriving by car, there are two convenient parking options near the apartment:

Mr. Parkit Garages
Mr. Parkit operates secure garages throughout central Prague. Simply enter the address of our apartment on their website, and they will recommend the nearest garage.
